statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-9080: calling curl_easy_pause() inside a CURLMOPT_SOCKETFUNCTION callback made libcurl write a flag through a pointer to memory it had just freed (a use after free) (https://curl.se/docs/CVE-2026-9080.html). It affects libcurl from 8.13.0 to 8.20.0 (not the curl tool) and was fixed in curl 8.21.0 by https://github.com/curl/curl/commit/5ab34cba42e4ee4282fe8bab43f311d51b9bf9bd. The DHI curl packages for Alpine 3.23 are builds of curl 8.17.0-r1, 8.18.0-r0 (in both the main and the security repository), 8.19.0-r0, 8.20.0-r0, 8.20.0-r1, 8.21.0-r0, 8.22.0-r0, 8.23.0-r0 and 8.23.0-r1, and the version string in each build's libcurl matches its package version. Every build before 8.21.0-r0 is a curl release in the affected range, and 8.21.0-r0 is the first build of curl 8.21.0, so it is the first fixed build.
